_readme: The recall probe (COLLECTION.md s3), 2026-10-07: what was diffed against the base and what each source added.

sources.source: the firm's live lists and job board
sources.result: 159 names, all in the base or partitioned

sources.source: archived lists 2008-2026 (Common Crawl) and the Internet Archive's index of per-company pages 2001-2013
sources.result: eight companies of 2001 to 2007 known only from their page address were added (asyntis, europroteome, internetwork, intime, iq, iscribe, music-united, vital-sensors); the 2001 to 2007 A to Z lists themselves were not readable (Internet Archive cooldown) and are debt

sources.source: the firm's press archive 2001-2010 and its 2024 and 2025 year-in-review posts
sources.result: no company outside the base; the 2025 review mentions two investments 'under wraps'
16 third-party registrants, each read (sources/edgar/fts-reading.json): none a new company
14 articles; Scoreloop and Wunderlist are in the base under their company names; Midas and UiPath are Digital East positions
Sennder added as its own row (new money in June 2020)

sources.source: parametric enumeration by era and sector (the judge's own list of Earlybird deals 1999 to 2026)
sources.result: no company missing from the base apart from Digital East Fund deals

rejected.name: Yoggie Security Systems
rejected.why: Wikipedia (Shlomo Touboul) lists 'Earlybird Venture Capital' among New York investors in Yoggie's first $1.8M: the New York firm is EarlyBirdCapital, Inc., the namesake (config desks.classify external); no Earlybird list or release names Yoggie
